runs.name: American Battery Materials, Inc.
runs.entry: Price **$4.00** (close 2026-10-09, aggregator, flagged) x **4,402,061 shares** (one class: 3,789,585 on the 10-Q cover, 0001493152-26-036860, plus 612,476 issued automatically to noteholders on 2026-09-30 under the 8-K of 2026-08-25, 0001493152-26-039978, the NYSE American uplist not being shown consummated in any filing) = cap **$17.6M** ($15.2M at 3,789,585); sovereign **5.60%** (UST 30Y, 2026-10-09). Primary document the FY2025 10-K (0001493152-26-011615, filed 2026-03-19); total assets at 2025-12-31, $396,365, cross-checked to the filed balance sheet. Former names BoxScore Brands, U-Vend, Internet Media Services; reverse splits 1-for-300 (2023-12-08) and 1-for-5 (2025-01-24). **Q1 OUT, a start-up**: an exploration-stage issuer with "no mineral reserves" and "no mining revenue to date", "no exploration or drilling conducted on the property", no test of direct lithium extraction, no customer, three employees, the 10-K itself placing it "alongside startups"; ruled out by name, **[L2007-015]**, **[M2008-088]**. The analyst sets down TOO HARD (NATURE) at Q1 as the alternative reading (section I sends a Q1 failure to TOO HARD while Q1's list rules start-ups OUT); either way no research pass. Integrity facts recorded, not judged: notes extended every quarter with principal step-ups of 10%, 10%, 12.5% and 15% plus shares; in H1 2026 noteholders received $3.6M of stock and step-ups against $270K of new note money; the chief executive and two directors are noteholders; a 17.5% evergreen plan reserve by written consent of insiders holding 54.37%; the named audit-committee financial expert resigned 2026-08-28; going-concern doubt; cash $5,704. Q2 to Q12 not reached. Beneath the stop, COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash (operating cash less stock pay less claim spending) negative every year FY2021-FY2025, average $(1.26)M; no-growth case alone: range $(7.93) a share all-equity ($(7.26) equity-only), fair $(5.71) all-equity ($(4.07) equity-only), net debt $12.67M. Balance sheets 2016 to June 2026: equity negative at every year-end ($(12.39)M at 2026-06-30), assets never above $1.74M, liabilities $12.7M all current after the 2022 conversions. Competitors: none files (Magrathea Metals a Form D only; Tidal Metals and US Magnesium not registrants); no comparison row. **Dispatcher's slip**: the brief said the DEF 14C of 2025-10-28 concerns a further reverse split; the analyst read it in full and its one action is the 17.5% evergreen plan. Citations: the analyst's check 20 fragments clean; the dispatcher's script (`fold_cite_check.py`) 20 ids present, 18 fragments, 0 slips. check_framework PASS. Analyst's gaps for the operator: (1) OUT or TOO HARD (NATURE) for a Q1 start-up, two analysts could box the same kind of name differently (AMBQ the cycle before was boxed TOO HARD (NATURE) at Q1 on a different ground, rapid technological change); (2) a negative fair price gives the alert nothing to arm; (3) `tools/run.py` window stopped at FY2018 (capex untagged after 2018); (4) not obtained: the notes' fate after 2026-09-30, the 2026-07-01 extension terms, the S-1/A's $16.75M note figure against the balance sheet.
runs.narr: Q1 OUT, a start-up: an exploration-stage lithium and magnesium brine claim holder in Utah with no reserves, no drilling, no customer and no revenue, grown from a failed vending shell, financed by notes that step up every quarter in principal and shares, insiders among the noteholders. Beneath the stop owner cash is negative every year; range $(7.93) and fair $(5.71) all-equity against $4.00. Gap reported: Q1's start-up row says OUT, section I says TOO HARD.
